messages:
Morgan: quick async Q — when a client sends both `model_id` and `routing_hints` (region/tier), what's the official contract for which wins and how fallbacks are reported? need this for an SDK PR + a couple integration tests.

Kai: short answer: `model_id` pins the served model if available in the requested region/tier. routing_hints are used as a tie-breaker / routing preference only when model is not pinned or not available. fallback order: 1) exact pinned model in requested region/tier 2) pinned model in other region/tier (if cross-region allowed) 3) compatible model variant in requested region/tier 4) compatible variant elsewhere.

Pranav: to add: release-2025-03 changed rule #2 to prefer same tier before cross-region; so ordering is slightly different now (same tier elsewhere > other tier same region). that might break some older clients if they relied on cross-region fallback.

Ana: thanks — do we document the response shape on fallback? SDK needs to expose which model served + why fallback happened.

Kai: yes — contract includes `served_model.id` and `served_model.variant` plus `routing_decision` object. example response body we intend to keep backward-compatible: 
```json
{
  "id": "resp_...",
  "output": "...",
  "served_model": {"id": "redwood-3b", "variant": "q4_0"},
  "routing_decision": {"initial_request": {"model_id": "redwood-3b-xx", "routing_hints": {"region": "us-west-2", "tier": "dedicated"}}, "final_route": {"region": "us-east-1", "tier": "shared", "reason": "model-not-present-in-requested-region"}}
}
```
This keeps the top-level fields the same; `routing_decision` is optional for older clients.

Lina: I'll add an integration test that asserts `served_model` + `routing_decision.final_route.reason` when we force a missing model in region. pinging @Sofia for canary config check.

Sofia: FYI the canary flag is `strict_model_pin=true` in rollout config. default is false to preserve backward compatibility. if QA wants strict behavior we flip the flag in canary and then roll.

Pranav: small note on semantics: when clients set `region: "*"` in routing_hints we treat it as "any region allowed"; older clients that omitted region get region affinity based on org defaults — that hasn't changed.

Morgan: perfect. for the SDK PR I'll map `routing_decision` to a typed object and add an opt-in `strictPin` boolean. can you all review the diff when I post?

Lina: will review.

Ana: leaving a quick code-review ping here — @Lina @Pranav @Kai please skim the contract docs update in the PR: https://git.redwood/dev/redwood/inference-sdk/pull/452

infra-bot: deploy scheduled: model-routing-rules-service v1.18 -> staging at 2025-05-01T03:14:00Z

Sofia: tagging release owners — if tests look good we can flip `strict_model_pin` in canary tomorrow.

Morgan: thanks all, followups: Lina adds tests, Kai updates docs snippet, Pranav confirms cross-region ordering in changelog, Ana updates SDK PR. I'll merge after approvals. :thumbsup:
